identity_contract.leakage_group_id: InChIKey connectivity-block hash; all stereochemistry/protonation variants sharing connectivity remain in one split group
identity_contract.molecule_id: full standardized InChIKey plus canonical-isomeric-SMILES representation hash; this prevents one molecule_id from mapping to multiple scaffolds when Standard InChI collapses reported tautomers
identity_contract.scaffold_group_id: Bemis-Murcko scaffold hash derived from the exact molecule representation identified by molecule_id, with an acyclic connectivity-specific fallback
identity_contract.split_rule: no leakage_group_id may appear in more than one data split, across all sources and tasks

measurement_definition: one physically present, parseable source record and explicit endpoint field; paired X/Y rows are joined once; candidate documents and well rows are not measurements

numeric_contract.approximate_or_unknown: retained in the measurement ledger but excluded from default modeling
numeric_contract.censored_objective_filter: eligible_censored_modeling == true; relation and bounds are mandatory model inputs
numeric_contract.interval: both lower_bound and upper_bound present only when physically supplied
numeric_contract.relation_equal: exact value; lower_bound and upper_bound are null
numeric_contract.relation_greater: right-censored lower boundary represented as lower_bound
numeric_contract.relation_less: left-censored upper boundary represented as upper_bound
numeric_contract.unit_rule: only explicit compatible conversions in code are normalized; missing source-native units remain source_native_scale

rights_contract: source_rights_status is mandatory; local model-readiness does not grant redistribution or commercial rights

scientific_boundary.allowed_use: source-native PK/ADME endpoint modeling preparation only

task_separation: task_id is mandatory; values from different task_id values must never be pooled into one target without a new reviewed harmonization contract
